speaker: margery_pell
text: I had it of a serjeant's wife, in the twopenny gallery, before the second act.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Had what, Margery?

speaker: margery_pell
text: The men taken for Tower Hill were tried at the Guildhall today. Five are condemned.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Five.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The charge?

speaker: margery_pell
text: Not riot. High treason. Levying war against the Queen.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: War, for pulling a thing down?

speaker: george_bryan
text: Gather a number to pull down what the Queen has set up, be it only a pillory, and the law may call it levying war. It was explained to me so once. I give it to thee the same way.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then a crowd is an army, if the bench says the word.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The bench has said it. That is all the law I have for thee.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have no jest for this.

speaker: john_heminges
text: When?

speaker: margery_pell
text: Nobody knows. The slips in Paul's Walk said the same, and no day on them.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then we do not put a day in our mouths.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John. I go into Warwickshire on Monday.

speaker: john_heminges
text: On what?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On these.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The fire, or this trial?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can hold the two. I cannot think about either.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then hold them, and come and take the paint off. The house is still going out.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: And the letter. Is the house stood?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: None of ours is touched, nor any of us hurt. Twenty houses, and a malt-barn. That is the letter.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Twenty is a town's count. You have it in her own hand?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In her hand. It is steady. Mine is not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Monday, then. We shall not keep you past Saturday.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The boxes were in before I spoke. The second act heard none of this.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Good. Let them laugh while there is a king to laugh at, and let this wait in the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is waiting. I am not thinking of it.
